newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merrill cuts rating, estimates on Daimler.
newsitem.headline: Merrill cuts rating, estimates on Daimler.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Friday it has cut its rating on German industrial group Daimler-Benz AG to intermediate reduce from neutral but left its long-term rating as hold.
"We think that estimates on Daimler will be coming down in general for 1998 reflecting the tax situation," said Merrill Lynch analyst Stephen Reitman in response to enquiries.

Reitman said he cut his earnings per share estimates after Daimler told analysts on Thursday that it expected a 40 percent tax burden in 1998 compared with receiving tax credits in the period from 1995 to 1997.
Reitman cut his 1997 earnings estimates on Daimler to 7.30 marks per share from 7.80 marks, while the 1998 earnings estimate was cut to 5.80 marks from 6.10 marks.

"We believe valuation at the moment is stretched. Daimler is now trading at about 27 times 1998 earnings and we think it should be trading closer to a market multiple closer to 21 times earnings," he said.
Daimler shares were down 3.65 marks at 149.20 marks in pre-bourse IBIS computer dealings.
